fields.why: The note defines females of reproductive age as 'persons aged 15–44 years and assigned female sex at birth', so age is population-defining as well as sex, and the brief records age always. B omitted age; the level (0) is unaffected.

A records pandemic-era health-service disruptions (STI clinic closures, diversion of public health resources), offered to explain changes over time in missed-opportunity categories, not social or structural determinants of a group difference. A's reading is defensible under the literal 'structural' wording; the rule needed is the same as for mm7242a2.

brief_issues: Same gap as mm7242a2: whether health-system or service disruptions (clinic closures, resource diversion) explaining a temporal change count as determinants_of_health when no SPD contrast exists.
